---
title: "Python Packaging Reference"
---

These practices recur across my Python projects: Great Tables, Great Docs, Pointblank, multimark,
nokap, weathervault, GridWell, Whittaker, Greenwood and GlassDelta. Each item is
something most or all of these projects do.

The practices are numbered, and the numbers run across all the pages, so a reference like
"item 21" means the same thing everywhere:

- [Packaging & Project Setup](project-setup.qmd): items 1–10
- [Testing](testing.qmd): item 11
- [CI & Repo Files](ci-and-repo-files.qmd): items 12–13
- [Code & API Design](code-and-api-design.qmd): items 14–23
- [Documentation](documentation.qmd): items 24–32

The `tinytab` package in this repository follows these practices, so each one can be seen
working in a real project layout.
